p: Eltham High Street is a busy south-east London shopping street with a real village feel in places, and it's got two cracking bits of history very close by.

Eltham Palace, run by English Heritage, mixes a medieval royal great hall with a stunning 1930s Art Deco house, and it's well worth an afternoon. Well Hall Pleasaunce, the old moated gardens off Well Hall Road, is free and lovely for a stroll. The Bob Hope Theatre, named after the comedian who was born in Eltham, is also in the area. Admiral itself is an 18+ adult gaming centre, so it's for grown-ups only. Lots of cafés, pubs and restaurants along the High Street round things off nicely.
